dct_description_sm: This campaign was part of the international OASIS-09 campaign (see http://www.OASIShome.net). The goal of the study was to obtain atmospheric composition data for furthering our understanding of atmospheric processes controlling and affecting atmospheric composition, particularly surface ozone and mercury depletion taking place in the spring time Arctic boundary layer. Complementary data are available in the Polar Data Catalogue, CCIN Reference Number 1840.
dct_title_s: OASIS-CANADA-OOTI Barrow-09: Atmospheric composition and structure during the international OASIS-09 campaign near Barrow, Alaska
